prompt: Perform one powerful right-facing boxing haymaker, then return to the exact original guard. First plant both feet and visibly coil the hips and shoulders backward, drawing the punching fist back beside the ribs while keeping the other glove near the face. Then step forward slightly, pivot the rear boot and rotate the whole torso into a wide sweeping horizontal punch toward the right. Fully extend the punching arm at shoulder height with a clear readable impact pose, then follow through, retract the arm and smoothly return to the initial stance. Strong anticipation, very fast punch, slower recovery. Keep the entire body visible inside the canvas. Preserve the character's face, body proportions, trunks pattern and boots in every pose. Only small existing flames on the glove; no large fire effect, no bird, no beam, no camera motion.
